item.title: She Couldn’t Let Him Go Then Investigators Uncovered The Plan
item.description: Brenda Delgado became fixated on her former boyfriend Ricardo Paniagua after he began dating Dallas dentist Kendra Hatcher. Prosecutors said Delgado recruited Crystal Cortes and Kristopher Love to target Hatcher in 2015, then fled to Mexico. Delgado was arrested in 2016, convicted in 2019, and sentenced to life without parole. Her conviction was upheld on appeal in 2021.

item.title: He Claimed Demons Were After Him Then Investigators Found The Truth
item.description: In October 2011, Kathleen McGehee was found dead at her home in Manteca, California, and suspicion quickly turned toward her son Dawson. During the investigation, Dawson described terrifying experiences involving demons and masks. He was later convicted of second degree murder and found legally sane, receiving a sentence of 15 years to life plus an additional year.
